title: skills: teach the action resultDialog, including the table format and its columns
body:
repo:objectstack#2 · os-steve · session_01ADHkmQ2SN4K183oqAvUajA

Filing gate ①: the `Skills-docs: follow-up` card owed by PR #34647 (Part of #33187; the action answer `table` format, whose contract landed in #34500), passed on by area `o2-B`. Dedupe: `resultDialog skill actions.md`; no open card.

Suggested-grade: p2 · domain:skills · Blocked-by #33187 (teach the shape only after the renderer lands)

## 维护者速读

- 现象:#34647 让动作的结果弹窗能把服务端返回的数组画成表格(`format: table` 加 `columns`)。教 AI 写 UI 动作的技能还没讲 `resultDialog`,更没讲表格这一格。
- 为什么要修：技能不教,AI 写「返回一批结果」的动作时只会用 `json` 或 `text` 格式，用户看到的是一坨原始数据。
- 需要你做的：无(落地时按受管面照常审批)。

## Change

After PR #34647 merges, add one bullet to `skills/objectstack-ui/rules/actions.md`, beside the `preflight` bullet. The PR body proposes this sentence; check it against the merged spec describe before using it:

> `resultDialog` — a one-shot dialog that shows the server answer: `fields: [{ path, label?, format? }]`, `format` one of `qrcode`, `code-list`, `secret`, `text`, `json`, or `table` with `columns: [{ path, label?, format? }]` (one row per element of the array at `path`, one cell per column; required with `table` and refused beside any other format).

Add one eval that writes an action returning a list of rows and checks it uses `format: table` with `columns`.

## Done when

The rule teaches it and the eval passes.

Blocked-by: #33187
